messi-demo.zh: 第一张卡。验证「一句话 → 四层素材 → Blender → 实时 3D」全链路跑通。
messi-demo.en: The very first card. It proved the full pipeline: one sentence → 4 layers → Blender → live 3D.

mj-demo.zh: 舞台光效与音乐主题的尝试——镭射质感第一次大改版。
mj-demo.en: A first pass at stage lighting and music themes — and the first big foil-effect upgrade.

frida-kahlo-mexican-painter.zh: 公开投稿画廊的第一张永久卡，也是展厅的第 6 张收藏。
frida-kahlo-mexican-painter.en: The first permanent card from the public-submission gallery — and the 6th in the hall.

snow-leopard-aurora-ridge.zh: 雪原与极光，野生动物在极光下的静谧瞬间。
snow-leopard-aurora-ridge.en: A snow leopard under the northern lights — wildlife in a frozen, glowing moment.

great-sage-sun-wukong.zh: 东方神话走进画廊：齐天大圣，傲世苍穹。
great-sage-sun-wukong.en: Eastern myth joins the hall: the Great Sage, defying heaven.

taikonaut-stellar-expedition.zh: 航天主题，星辰大海的远征。
taikonaut-stellar-expedition.en: A space expedition — dreams among the stars.

marco-reus-bvb-kapitain.zh: 德国球星系列开篇：多特蒙德队长，德语卡背。
marco-reus-bvb-kapitain.en: First German card — the BVB captain, with a German back story.

marco-reus-wm-2014-verpasst.zh: 国家队篇章：2014 年那个错过的大力神杯之夜。
marco-reus-wm-2014-verpasst.en: The national-team chapter — the 2014 night the trophy slipped away.

marco-reus-la-galaxy-neue-horizonte.zh: 罗伊斯远赴美职联的新章节。
marco-reus-la-galaxy-neue-horizonte.en: Reus' new chapter across the Atlantic.

satyajit-ray-bengali-maestro.zh: 孟加拉语文字层与西孟加拉字体验证——致敬电影大师。
satyajit-ray-bengali-maestro.en: Bengali text layer and font rendering verified — a tribute to the film maestro.

neeltje-friesian-kalundborg.zh: 朋友的马：密码解锁的私藏卡，卡背是一段丹麦语故事。
neeltje-friesian-kalundborg.en: A friend's horse — a passcode-locked private card with a Danish story.

card-elijah-lin-d.zh: 第一张真实公众投稿——自动审核 + 自动渲染管线正式上线。
card-elijah-lin-d.en: The first real public submission — the auto-review & auto-render pipeline went live.

messi-fc-barcelona.zh: 「巴萨传承」001：诺坎普之夜，红蓝十年。
messi-fc-barcelona.en: FC Barcelona Legacy 001 — a night at Camp Nou.

johan-cruyff-el-arquitecto.zh: 传承 005：现代足球的建筑师，克圣。
johan-cruyff-el-arquitecto.en: Legacy 005 — the architect of modern football.

messi-inter-miami.zh: 传承 003：新大陆的传奇，迈阿密之夏。
messi-inter-miami.en: Legacy 003 — a legend in the New World.

messi-world-cup-2022.zh: 传承 004：第三颗星，卡塔尔之夜。
messi-world-cup-2022.en: Legacy 004 — the third star, the Doha night.

pep-guardiola-tiki-taka.zh: 传承 006：系列收官——战术大师瓜迪奥拉。
pep-guardiola-tiki-taka.en: Legacy 006 — the maestro closes the series.

eletrico-28-lisboa.zh: 里斯本的城市名片——28 路黄色电车。选择性着色：电车全彩、老城黑白，献给热爱这座城市的 Inês。
eletrico-28-lisboa.en: Lisbon's moving icon — the yellow Tram 28. Selective color: the tram glows, the old city fades to monochrome. Dedicated to Inês, whose love for Lisbon made this card possible.

haaland-machine-robot.zh: 哈兰德多重宇宙开篇：111 球 0 情绪，机器人梗首发，呆萌不炫酷。
haaland-machine-robot.en: Opening of the Haaland Multiverse: 111 goals, zero feelings — the robot meme, cute not cool.

haaland-meditation.zh: 打坐庆祝名场面进画廊——别人呐喊，我入定。
haaland-meditation.en: The lotus-pose celebration joins the hall — the world screams, he meditates.

haaland-majin-buu.zh: 撞脸《龙珠》魔人布欧实锤，本人回应「我不否认」。
haaland-majin-buu.en: The Majin Buu face-match, confirmed by his own words: 'I don't disagree.'

haaland-moskau-anthem.zh: 《哈哈哈兰德》神曲篇——哈兰哈兰，哈哈哈哈。
haaland-moskau-anthem.en: The anthem chapter — Haalaland, ha-ha-ha-ha-land. Wash your brain, then keep singing.

haaland-viking-kriger.zh: 维京战士（挪威语卡）——谷歌彩蛋「维京划船」的致敬。
haaland-viking-kriger.en: The Viking warrior (in Norwegian) — a tribute to Google's Viking Row easter egg.

kenji-kishimoto.zh: 《破碎的我》里会隐身的日裔美籍抵抗战士——Omega Point 的隐形心脏，战争里最锐利的讽刺旁白者。
kenji-kishimoto.en: The invisible heart of Omega Point — the Japanese-American resistance fighter from Shatter Me who vanishes into the war's best one-liners.

pouch-invader.zh: 朋友 Lay 投稿的搞笑卡——猫强占袋鼠育儿袋，副标题 The Laytenant 三合一双关（中尉/租客/Lay）。
pouch-invader.en: A comedy card from friend Lay — the cat claims the pouch; the kangaroo never signed up. Subtitle pun: The Laytenant = lieutenant + tenant + Lay.

haaland-magdeburg.zh: 爆射贴脸被封「人类高质量马德堡半球实验」，物理课本风梗卡。
haaland-magdeburg.en: The shot so hard the ball stayed glued to a defender's face — textbook-illustration meme.

haaland-eat-kid.zh: 世界杯广告「生吃小孩」Q 版化，黑色幽默变呆萌。
haaland-eat-kid.en: The 'eat-the-kid' World Cup ad, Q-versioned into adorable black humor.

haaland-raccoon.zh: 世界杯后扛浣熊标本 + 威士忌下飞机，机场狗仔名场面梗卡。
haaland-raccoon.en: Post-World Cup arrival with a raccoon and a whisky — airport paparazzi gold.

haaland-wanglaoji.zh: 7.5 亿阅读的蹩脚中文王老吉广告，红金喜庆梗卡。
haaland-wanglaoji.en: The 750M-reads Wanglaoji ad with his earnest Chinese — festive fire-breathing meme.

haaland-bun-haartie.zh: 90 分钟不散的丸子头 + 淘宝 3 万搜索同款发圈，时尚单品海报梗卡。
haaland-bun-haartie.en: The 90-minute-proof bun and his 30k-search hair tie, styled as a fashion-poster meme.

haaland-shark-grin.zh: 哈兰德标志性鲨鱼牙大笑，全网表情包级。这次不冷峻，直接深海化。
haaland-shark-grin.en: Haaland's signature shark-tooth grin, meme-wild and deep-sea blue. The Machine is cool; the Shark is happy.

haaland-scallion.zh: 中国网民拿大葱根茎复刻哈兰德金发前倾庆祝体态，他本人主动转发。大葱即本人，田园即球场。
haaland-scallion.en: Chinese fans recreated Haaland's celebration with a scallion — and he reposted it himself. The scallion IS the striker.

haaland-goalie-water.zh: 哈兰德场上偷喝对手门将水瓶被抓包的名场面，尴尬假笑定格。机器人也会渴。
haaland-goalie-water.en: Haaland's famous sideline water-bottle heist, caught in 4K with a sheepish grin. Even robots get thirsty.

haaland-tom-cat.zh: 网友发现哈兰德神似《猫和老鼠》Tom：金发、蓝白配色、锲而不舍。Jerry 和 111 个后卫都跑不掉。
haaland-tom-cat.en: The internet's face-match of the century: Haaland IS Tom from Tom & Jerry. Jerry never stood a chance — neither did 111 defenders.

haaland-chongqing-metro.zh: 网友玩'重庆必吃榜'梗，哈兰德真拍视频张嘴吞穿楼轻轨。李子坝名场面，山城魔幻遇上梗王。
haaland-chongqing-metro.en: "Chongqing's must-eat list" — fans joked the metro-through-building is a dish, and Haaland actually filmed himself eating it.

vc-lance-vance.zh: 兰斯是汤米第一个盟友，也是全游戏最魔性的名场面——霓虹舞池里那段笨拙又自信的舞步成了无数玩家的童年记忆。只是没人想到，跳舞的兄弟最后会把枪口对准你。
vc-lance-vance.en: The most memed dance in gaming, from the brother who'd later betray you. Disco ball, purple suit, and a prophecy.

vc-ricardo-diaz.zh: 迪亚兹是罪恶城最大的毒枭，傲慢、残暴、自以为无人能撼动。可惜他惹错了人——Rub Out 一役，老毒枭的雪茄在自家庄园永远熄了。
vc-ricardo-diaz.en: The drug lord who ruled Vice City with a mansion, a cigar and pure arrogance — until Tommy paid a visit.

vc-auntie-poulet.zh: 波莱特是小海地区的巫毒女巫，用蜡烛和咒语给汤米'祝福'——皮糙肉厚、伤口快速愈合。罪恶城最魔幻的一页，写在烟雾缭绕的巫毒小店里。
vc-auntie-poulet.en: Vice City's strangest ally: candles, spirits and blessings that actually work. The voodoo queen of Little Haiti.
